title: Struggling Packers lose Zach Bako-Bewele for the season to torn patellar tendon

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Struggling Packers lose Zach Bako-Bewele for the season to torn patellar tendon
sources.description: A rough start to Green Bay's season took another turn for the worse on Tuesday with news of the loss of arguably their best offensive lineman for the season.
